title: Not getting Temp Basals as a Nightscout Follower
body: I have the "Show Basal TBR" setting checked in "Graph Settings". And we get all the other data as expected, all except for the Basal Patterns.

comments.body: I'll send a PR soon that will solve this.
@tzachi-dar Will PR #868 resolve this issue also?  Graph looks great showing the basals!  Thank you!

Hi I'm seeing this as well. 

fwiw, I'm using Xdrip+ 2020.11.27 on a Pixel 2 XL (running Android 11). Xdrip+ is configured with: Hardware data source: Nightscout follower; 'Download treatments' enabled. A separate NS client is not installed.

Xdrip+ displays BG data, carb entries, and boluses correctly, however basal rate adjustments don't show.

What is the status of this?
Have you tested the latest Nightly and enabled download treatments?
Please try with the latest Nightly and if the problem persists, please let me know.
